initial.name: session_search
initial.description: Search prior sessions in the caller workspace and return the strongest matching event from each session.

query.description: Literal full-text query over prior session history.

created_at_from.description: Inclusive timezone-qualified ISO 8601 creation-time lower bound.

created_at_to.description: Inclusive timezone-qualified ISO 8601 creation-time upper bound.

include_root_sessions.description: Include sessions with no parent in the parent filter.

availability.description: Require at least one selected source availability.

event_time_from.description: Inclusive timezone-qualified ISO 8601 event-time lower bound.

event_time_to.description: Inclusive timezone-qualified ISO 8601 event-time upper bound.

initial.name: session_event_search
initial.description: Search prior events in one authorized session; the current session excludes the step performing this call.

session_id.description: Target session id. Omit for the current session.

query.description: Literal full-text query over the target session.

time_from.description: Inclusive timezone-qualified ISO 8601 event-time lower bound.

time_to.description: Inclusive timezone-qualified ISO 8601 event-time upper bound.

initial.name: session_trace
initial.description: Read the authorized session lineage around one session, including complete visible ancestor and descendant relationships.

session_id.description: Target session id. Omit for the current session.

initial.name: session_event_trace
initial.description: Read every direct replacement and relationship to a cited source event for one event in an authorized session.

session_id.description: Target session id. Omit for the current session.

initial.name: session_event_read
initial.description: Read one full unabridged event and optional neighboring raw-event summaries from an authorized session.

session_id.description: Target session id. Omit for the current session.

before.description: Number of preceding raw events to summarize. Omit for none.

after.description: Number of following raw events to summarize. Omit for none.

initial.name: get_goal
initial.description: Read the current same-session goal, including its exact id/revision, objective, phase, completed continuation rounds, round limit, blocker reason when present, and whether another continuation is armed. Call this before updating a goal.

initial.name: create_goal
initial.description: Create one persisted same-session completion goal when the current direct human request is a long-running objective that should continue across autonomous goal rounds. You may infer that intent without requiring the user to say "create a goal". Do not use this for trivial single-turn work. Execution rejects non-human and subagent authority.

max_goal_rounds.description: Optional positive safe-integer automatic round cap.

initial.name: update_goal
initial.description: Update the exact Goal revision. edit, pause and resume require a direct top-level human turn. complete and blocked also accept the exact autonomous Goal round. blocked requires the configured minimum round count.

initial.name: workflow
initial.description: Run a foreground JavaScript workflow body with top-level await and return JSON. Hooks: agent(prompt, {schema?, label?, phase?, provider?, model?}), parallel(thunks), pipeline(items, ...stages), phase(title), log(message), args. Child failures become null; invalid options, unsupported schemas and resource caps fail the run. No filesystem, network, timers or Node APIs are provided. The worker is containment, not a security boundary.

initial.name: ralph
initial.description: Run a foreground fresh-agent Ralph loop toward one immutable objective. Use only when the direct human explicitly asks for Ralph or fresh-agent iteration. Each round opens a new child with no parent conversation or prior child session; the shared workspace is long-term memory, and only a bounded structured report crosses rounds. The call returns when a worker reports completion or a concrete blocker, or at the round limit. Ordinary long-running same-session work belongs to goal tools.

objective.description: The immutable completion objective for every fresh Ralph round.

maxRounds.description: Optional positive safe-integer round cap, bounded by the deployment ceiling.

initial.name: job_output
initial.description: Read retained live or final background job output and status; optionally wait for completion.

initial.name: job_list
initial.description: List background jobs owned by this Agent.

initial.name: job_kill
initial.description: Request cancellation of one background job owned by this Agent.

initial.name: todo_write
initial.description: Record and update a structured task list for the current work. Send the ENTIRE list every call — it REPLACES the previous list (there are no partial updates, no per-item edits). Use it to plan multi-step work and show progress: add one todo per concrete step before you start. Mark every todo being actively worked on `in_progress` — several at once when work genuinely runs in parallel (e.g. concurrent subagents or background commands), one for sequential work; while work remains, at least one task should be `in_progress`. Mark a todo `completed` the moment it is done (do not batch completions), and allow no `in_progress` item only once all work is complete. Skip the list for trivial single-step tasks. Statuses: `pending` (not started), `in_progress` (being worked on now), `completed` (finished).

todos.description: The COMPLETE task list, replacing any previous list.

content.description: What the task is — a short imperative line.

initial.name: read
initial.description: Read a UTF-8 text file and return line-numbered content.

file_path.description: Path to read, resolved by the filesystem backend.

offset.description: 1-based first line to return. Defaults to 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return. Defaults to 2000.

initial.name: read_image
initial.description: Read a PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF file and return the image itself. The current model must declare image input.

file_path.description: Path to the image file, resolved by the filesystem backend.

initial.name: write
initial.description: Create or fully replace a UTF-8 text file.

file_path.description: Path to write, resolved by the filesystem backend.

content.description: Full UTF-8 text content to write.

sandbox_permissions.description: The wider sandbox mode this file operation needs. Only valid as a one-shot retry of an operation the sandbox just denied; requires justification and user approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access.

initial.name: edit
initial.description: Edit an existing UTF-8 text file by replacing literal text.

file_path.description: Path to edit, resolved by the filesystem backend.

old_string.description: Literal text to replace. Must match exactly.

new_string.description: Literal replacement text. Use an empty string to delete the match.

replace_all.description: Replace all matches. Defaults to false; when false, old_string must appear exactly once.

sandbox_permissions.description: The wider sandbox mode this file operation needs. Only valid as a one-shot retry of an operation the sandbox just denied; requires justification and user approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access.

initial.name: glob
initial.description: Find files whose paths match a glob pattern. Returns matching file paths — never directories — including hidden and ignored files (VCS metadata directories are excluded). Up to 100 paths come back in modification-time order; a larger result returns the first 100 paths in modification-time order, says so, and reports where the complete sorted list was saved. This tool does not enumerate directory entries.

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match file paths against (e.g. "**/*.ts", "src/**/*.test.js"). A pattern with no "/" matches the basename at any depth, so "*" and "*.ts" both search the whole tree; include a separator to anchor the depth.

path.description: Directory to search in. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

initial.name: grep
initial.description: Search file contents with a ripgrep regular expression. Returns matching lines with line numbers, grouped by file. Returns the first 250 matches inline; a capped result reports where the complete match list was saved. Use read on a matched file for surrounding context.

pattern.description: Regular expression to search for (ripgrep syntax).

path.description: File or directory to search. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

include.description: One glob filter for which files to search (e.g. "*.ts", "*.{js,jsx}"). Not a list; negation is not supported.

initial.name: web_search
initial.description: Search the web for current information. Provide 1–4 queries in the required queries array. Returns an optional summary answer and a list of source URLs.

queries.description: Required search queries; accepts 1–4 items and merges their results.

initial.name: web_fetch
initial.description: Fetch the content of a specific HTTP(S) URL and return it decoded to text.

initial.name: pwsh
initial.description: Execute a fresh PowerShell command and return stdout, stderr, and an exit marker. Use native Windows paths and $env:NAME variables; pass workdir instead of cd. Nonzero exits are results, while process failures are errors. A file sandbox may deny access; inspect the denial marker and do not work around it. Set run_in_background for longer work; use job_output to read its live output and job_kill to stop it. On Windows, restricted execution uses ConstrainedLanguageMode and blocks unsafe named-pipe access. After a real denial, retry the exact command once with the narrowest wider sandbox_permissions and a one-sentence justification; the approval prompt asks the user. A rejected escalation is final for that command.

command.description: PowerShell source to run in a fresh shell.

description.description: Brief description of the command for the user.

timeoutMs.description: Foreground timeout in milliseconds, capped by the executor.

workdir.description: Working directory; relative paths use the Session workspace.

run_in_background.description: Start a managed job without a command timeout.

sandbox_permissions.description: Wider file-access mode for a denied command.

justification.description: One sentence explaining why the exact command needs wider access.
